q: In Capernaum, how many men carried the paralyzed man to Jesus?
why: His friends carried him on a mat.
quote: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.

q: Why did the paralyzed man's friends open up the roof of the house?
why: The house was packed with people.
quote: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him

q: How did the friends get the paralyzed man to Jesus in the crowded house?
why: Nothing stopped them from bringing their friend to Jesus.
quote: made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.

q: When Jesus saw the friends' faith, what did He first say to the paralyzed man?
why: Jesus cared about his heart first.
quote: Son, your sins are forgiven.

q: When Jesus forgave the paralyzed man, who did the scribes say alone can forgive sins?
why: Jesus showed He has God's authority.
quote: Who can forgive sins but God alone?

q: What did Jesus tell the healed paralyzed man to pick up and take home?
why: The man walked out in front of everyone.
quote: get up, pick up your mat, and go home.

q: After the paralyzed man walked out healed, what did the amazed crowd say?
why: They glorified God.
quote: We have never seen anything like this!

q: When Jesus and His disciples crossed the sea one evening, what came up?
why: Waves broke over the boat.
quote: Soon a violent windstorm came up

q: During the storm on the sea, what was Jesus doing in the boat?
why: He was not afraid of the storm.
quote: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion.

q: When the disciples woke Jesus in the storm, what did they ask Him?
a: Don't You care we are perishing?
why: They were terrified.
quote: Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?

q: In the storm, what did Jesus say to the wind and the sea?
why: Even the weather obeys Him.
quote: “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!”

q: After Jesus rebuked the wind on the sea, what happened?
why: The storm stopped at His word.
quote: And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.

q: After calming the storm, what did Jesus ask His disciples?
why: He wanted them to have faith.
quote: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked.

q: After Jesus stopped the storm, what did the disciples ask one another?
a: Who is this that the wind obeys?
why: They were amazed at His power.
quote: Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?

q: What was Jairus, the man who fell at Jesus' feet and begged for help?
why: He came for his sick daughter.
quote: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived

q: Why did Jairus beg Jesus to come to his house?
why: He believed Jesus could heal her.
quote: My little daughter is near death.

q: While Jesus was on the way to Jairus's house, what news arrived?
why: The messengers thought it was too late.
quote: Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?

q: When Jairus heard his daughter had died, what did Jesus tell him?
a: Do not be afraid; just believe
why: Jesus was about to do the impossible.
quote: Do not be afraid; just believe.

q: At Jairus's house, what did Jesus say about the girl?
a: She is not dead, but asleep
why: For Jesus, death was like sleep.
quote: The child is not dead, but asleep.

q: When Jesus said Jairus's daughter was only asleep, how did the mourners react?
why: They knew she had died.
quote: And they laughed at Him.

q: How old was Jairus's daughter when Jesus raised her?
why: She got up and walked around.
quote: She was twelve years old

q: After raising Jairus's daughter, what did Jesus tell them to give her?
why: She was truly alive and hungry.
quote: and He told them to give her something to eat.

q: As Jesus was leaving which city did He meet blind Bartimaeus by the road?
why: Bartimaeus sat by the road begging.
quote: as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho

q: What did blind Bartimaeus cry out when he heard Jesus passing by?
a: Son of David, have mercy on me!
why: He believed Jesus was the promised King.
quote: “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

q: When people told blind Bartimaeus to be quiet, what did he do?
why: He would not give up.
quote: but he cried out all the louder

q: When Jesus called him, what did blind Bartimaeus throw off?
why: He jumped up and came to Jesus.
quote: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.

q: When Jesus asked what he wanted, what did blind Bartimaeus ask for?
why: He asked for what only Jesus could give.
quote: let me see again.

q: What did Jesus say had healed blind Bartimaeus?
why: He trusted Jesus.
quote: your faith has healed you.

q: After he could see, what did Bartimaeus do?
why: He became a follower of Jesus.
quote: And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

q: When people brought little children to Jesus, what did the disciples do?
why: They thought Jesus was too busy.
quote: and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

q: How did Jesus feel when the disciples turned the children away?
why: Children matter to Jesus.
quote: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant

q: What did Jesus tell His disciples about the little children?
why: He told them not to stop the children.
quote: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!

q: When the children came to Him, Jesus said the kingdom of God belongs to whom?
why: God welcomes those who come like children.
quote: For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

q: Blessing the children, Jesus said we must receive God's kingdom like what?
why: With simple trust.
quote: anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.

q: What did Jesus do with the children who were brought to Him?
why: He placed His hands on them.
quote: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.

q: How does the Gospel of Mark open?
wrong: In the beginning was the Word
A record of the family line
In the days of King Herod
why: Mark calls Jesus the Son of God from the start.
quote: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

q: In Mark, what did Jesus do early in the morning while it was still dark?
a: Went to a solitary place to pray
why: Jesus made time to be alone with God.
quote: Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.

q: In the region of the Gerasenes, what did the man with the unclean spirit say his name was?
why: He said, “for we are many.”
quote: “My name is Legion,” he replied

q: When Jesus cast the spirits out of the man called Legion, where did they go?
why: The herd rushed into the sea.
quote: the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs

q: How long had the woman who touched Jesus' cloak suffered from bleeding?
why: Doctors had not helped her.
quote: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.

q: What did the sick woman in the crowd believe would heal her?
why: Her bleeding stopped at once.
quote: If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.

q: What did Jesus tell the woman who was healed by touching His cloak?
why: He called her “Daughter.”
quote: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.

q: In Jesus' hometown, what work did people say He did?
why: They took offense at Him.
quote: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary

q: When Jesus sent out the Twelve, how did He send them?
why: He gave them authority over unclean spirits.
quote: and began to send them out two by two

q: When Jesus healed a deaf man, which Aramaic word did He say?
why: It means, “Be opened!”
quote: “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).

q: After Jesus first touched the blind man at Bethsaida, what did people look like to him?
why: Jesus touched his eyes again and he saw clearly.
quote: but they look like trees walking around.

q: Jesus asked what it profits a man to gain the whole world, yet lose what?
why: The soul is worth more than the world.
quote: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?

q: What did the father of the troubled boy cry out to Jesus?
a: I do believe; help my unbelief!
why: Jesus had said all things are possible for one who believes.
quote: I do believe; help my unbelief!

q: Jesus said whoever wants to be first must be what?
a: Last of all and servant of all
why: Greatness in God's kingdom means serving.
quote: he must be the last of all and the servant of all.

q: What did Jesus tell the rich young man to do with everything he owned?
a: Sell it and give to the poor
why: Then he would have treasure in heaven.
quote: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor

q: Why did the rich young man go away sad after talking with Jesus?
why: He loved his riches too much.
quote: because he had great wealth.

q: Jesus said the Son of Man came not to be served, but to do what?
a: To serve and give His life
why: He gave His life as a ransom for many.
quote: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.

q: What did the poor widow put into the temple treasury?
why: Jesus was watching the givers.
quote: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins

q: Why did Jesus say the poor widow gave more than all the others?
why: The others gave out of their extra.
quote: but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.

q: Who was forced to carry the cross of Jesus?
why: He was passing by from the country.
quote: Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by

q: On the way to Jesus' tomb, what were the women worried about?
a: Who would roll away the stone
why: The stone was very large, but it was already rolled away.
quote: Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?

q: In Mark, where did the risen Jesus tell His disciples to go and preach the gospel?
why: The gospel is for every creature.
quote: Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.

q: In which town was the house where the paralyzed man was lowered through the roof?
why: Jesus had come back home there.
quote: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum.

q: During the storm on the sea, in which part of the boat was Jesus sleeping?
why: He slept on a cushion.
quote: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion.

q: When Jesus met the man called Legion, which region had He sailed to?
why: It was on the other side of the sea.
quote: they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.

q: About how many pigs rushed into the sea when the unclean spirits entered them?
why: The herd drowned in the water.
quote: and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea

q: What words did Jesus say when He took Jairus's daughter by the hand?
why: It means, “Little girl, get up!”
quote: Jesus said, “Talitha koum!”

q: Which disciples did Jesus allow to go with Him to Jairus's house?
why: He let no one else come along.
quote: except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

q: Blind Bartimaeus was the son of whom?
why: Bar-timaeus means son of Timaeus.
quote: a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus

q: What title did blind Bartimaeus use when he asked Jesus to heal him?
why: It means my teacher.
quote: “Rabboni,” said the blind man

q: In Bethany, in whose home did a woman pour perfume on Jesus' head?
why: Jesus was reclining at the table there.
quote: in the home of Simon the Leper

q: What was the expensive perfume poured on Jesus' head in Bethany made of?
why: It came in an alabaster jar.
quote: a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard.

q: Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross, was the father of whom?
why: Mark's readers may have known his sons.
quote: the father of Alexander and Rufus

q: According to Mark, at what hour was Jesus crucified?
why: That is about nine in the morning.
quote: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
